why_what_how:
WHY. Agents are moving from pilots into everyday software. Gartner predicts that 40 percent of enterprise applications will integrate task-specific agents by 2026, up from under 5 percent [gartner-apps-2026]. KPMG's Q3 2026 pulse found 62 percent of US organizations with revenue of $1 billion or more building, deploying or developing agents [kpmg-agents-q3-2026]. Sizing firms forecast the AI-agents market at US$48.3 billion [agents-mkt-bcc] to US$52.62 billion [agents-mkt-mnm] by 2030.

Governance trails deployment. Gartner expects the average Global Fortune 500 enterprise to run more than 150,000 agents by 2028 [gartner-sprawl-2028], yet only 15 percent of surveyed IT application leaders were considering, piloting or deploying fully autonomous agents [gartner-autonomy-2025], and 49 percent of KPMG respondents have defined high-risk use cases closed to autonomous agent decisions [kpmg-highrisk-q3-2026]. Gartner also predicts over 40 percent of agentic AI projects will be discontinued by the end of 2027 [gartner-cancel-2027]. Rules are arriving: the EU AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024 and became applicable on 2 August 2026 [gov-euaiact-force], with high-risk rules for areas such as critical infrastructure and education applying from 2 December 2027 [gov-euaiact-highrisk]. NIST's voluntary AI RMF dates from January 2023 [gov-nist-rmf].

AGI Future Foundation PBC exists to ensure advanced AI is governed as a public good, with benefits shared widely and deployed toward humanity's most urgent challenges (worlds/PBC.json). Its model gives agents research synthesis, task routing, proposal generation and operational coordination, and keeps oversight, values alignment, final governance and accountability with humans.

WHAT. SmartCiti.X is a network of agent-managed, human-governed virtual worlds. Agents operate; people govern: governance.final_vote, charter.amend, treasury.transfer, proposal.enact, windfall.distribute and steward.appoint are held for a human Steward Council. The Omega Stewards are defined, not seated, and every voice is synthetic and says so.

Adjacent markets are unsettled. 2030 virtual-world estimates run from ABI Research's virtual spaces approaching US$45 billion [vw-abi-45bn], through Statista's US$490 billion against other analysts' approximately 750 to 1,700 billion [vw-statista-490bn] and the European Commission's over EUR 800 billion [vw-eu-800bn], to Citi's US$8 to 13 trillion addressable market [vw-citi-13tn]. Headsets slumped: IDC expected mixed and virtual reality headset shipments to fall 42.8 percent in 2025 [xr-idc-headsets-2025], and its mixed-reality outlook moved from over 15.2 million units by 2029, already slightly lowered [xr-idc-mr-lowered-2025], to 10.4 million by 2030 [xr-idc-mr-2026], even as IDC expected smart glasses to lift the combined category 39.2 percent [xr-idc-glasses-2025]. Digital twins are forecast at USD 149.81 billion by 2030 [dt-mnm-2030]; the EU's CitiVERSE consortium aims to onboard about 100 cities [city-eu-citiverse]; cities already house 45 percent of 8.2 billion people [city-un-45pct].

HOW. We read these numbers as context, not traction: forecasts are not facts, and this project has no revenue, users, customers or partnerships to report. The worlds are not mounted in Sneeze, nothing is deployed or minted on any chain, most worlds have no anchor chosen, and RP1 publication is the founder's call. What we offer is a working pattern, agents doing operational work under explicit permissions while people hold the final decisions, built to be inspected rather than taken on trust.
caveats: Market-size estimates diverge widely because each publisher defines the market differently: 2030 virtual-world figures range from ABI Research's virtual spaces approaching US$45 billion to Citi's US$8 to 13 trillion addressable market. They are forecasts, not facts, and several date from 2022 and 2023.

Several forecasts have been revised down. IDC called its June 2025 mixed-reality forecast 'slightly lowered', and its July 2026 outlook (10.4 million units by 2030) is lower than its June 2025 one (over 15.2 million by 2029). The editions cover different horizons, so the side-by-side comparison is ours, not IDC's. A Counterpoint June 2026 XR update was reported to revise its AR smart-glasses forecast down, but its page was behind a bot check and it is not cited.

Gartner's newsroom pages returned a bot check to automated retrieval, which was not bypassed. Gartner figures are quoted from trade and press reports (PEX Network, Silicon, The Register), and the Gartner release URL is given in primary_url where known. Recheck the wording against Gartner's own pages before publication.
McKinsey's State of AI pages timed out on automated retrieval, so no McKinsey figures are used.

Survey figures describe specific samples, not whole populations. For example, KPMG's Q3 2026 pulse covered 314 US leaders at organizations with $1 billion or more in revenue, fielded July 24 to Aug. 25, 2026; Gartner's autonomy figure comes from 360 IT application leaders in 2025.

The EU AI Act dates reflect the 'AI Omnibus' amendment as the Commission's AI Act page described it on 2026-10-12. The high-risk dates differ from those in the Regulation as originally adopted. Recheck before publication.
The European Commission's EUR 800 billion page does not describe its method. CitiVERSE's 'about 100 cities within two years' was a December 2024 target, not an achieved count.
Statista updates its pages. The cited chart is dated Feb 17, 2023. Statista's live Metaverse Market Insights page, accessed 2026-10-12, shows a different figure (US$507.8bn by 2030).
UN DESA's 2025 urbanization revision uses a new city definition, so its 45 per cent is not directly comparable with earlier editions.
AGI Future Foundation PBC and SmartCiti.X have no revenue, users, customers, partnerships or traction to report. External market growth is not evidence of demand for this project.
The narrative deliberately leaves out project counts (worlds, cards, avatars and so on). Those numbers should be read from the registry files at build time, with their sources named.
Every quote was checked verbatim against the page text fetched on 2026-10-12 (HTML stripped, whitespace normalised). Some quotes are contiguous fragments of a longer sentence.
